caption: The setup page loads with name, email, password and repeat-password fields.
Passwords that don't match are caught in the browser; nothing is sent.
A weak password is refused by the server with a clear message.
An invalid email address can't be submitted (browser validation bubble).
Account created: the operator lands in the platform console overview.
Tenants page opens (empty: no factory companies yet).
The New tenant form (company, plan, country and its first administrator). Closed without saving.
Plans & pricing page shows the four plans with limits and modules.
The audit log recorded the setup and the sign-in, with time and IP address.
Signed out. The 'first-time setup' link no longer appears because an operator now exists.
A wrong password is refused without revealing whether the email exists.
Signed in again with the right password.
Still signed in after reloading the page (session restored automatically).
The audit log now also shows the failed and the successful sign-in.
Running setup a second time is refused: 'The platform is already set up.'
The setup page on a phone-width screen.
